issue_or_decision: Observation coordinates differed slightly among files or were missing
action_taken: Used DMNP_Site_List.xlsx as the reference representation of unique monitoring locations while retaining source coordinates in the working data

issue_or_decision: Source times were recorded as HH:MM and did not include seconds
action_taken: Formatted times as HH:MM:SS by appending :00; seconds were not measured in the source data

issue_or_decision: Source files did not include time zone values
action_taken: Assigned -04:00 after fictional data owner confirmation that source times represent Atlantic Daylight Time

issue_or_decision: Source files used local names, units, and characteristic conventions
affected_records: DO; Temp; SpCond; Pb; Nitrate-N; Hardness
action_taken: Mapped source information to DataStream characteristic, unit, sample-fraction, and speciation fields where supported by the metadata

issue_or_decision: Some results were reported relative to a detection or reporting limit rather than as exact numeric values
action_taken: Represented these records using a detection condition and preserved limit values, units, and types only where supported by the source data

issue_or_decision: Sample fraction remains unresolved for selected lead and copper records
action_taken: Retained missing sample fraction as NA rather than assuming dissolved, total, or total recoverable
